premise: Caterpillar eats and eats, wraps herself up tight, and Ladybug waits beside her until a butterfly opens its wings.
inspiration: The waiting tales of folk tradition and the seasons of Aesop's Ant and Grasshopper, turned kind: the one who waits is a friend, and the change is a wonder.
lesson: Some changes take time, and a friend waits with you.
learning: A caterpillar wraps itself up and comes out as a butterfly

en-US.title: Caterpillar's Long Sleep
en-US.text: Caterpillar {caterpillar:pulse} was hungry. {sfx:munch} Munch, munch, she ate a leaf. Munch, munch, she ate another. [giggles] That tickles! laughed the tree {tree:wobble 0.4}. Then one day, Caterpillar said: [yawns] I'm so sleepy. She wrapped herself up tight in a little case, and hung from a branch, very, very still. {caterpillar:fade-out hold} Ladybug {ladybug:pulse} waited beside her. One day. Two days. Lots of days. [curious] Is she ever coming out? Ladybug asked the tree. [softly] Wait and see, said the tree. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} And one sunny morning, the little case wobbled… and cracked… and out came… [gasps] a butterfly! {butterfly:fade-in} {butterfly:sparkle} It's me, said the butterfly. It's Caterpillar! [happily] And Ladybug {ladybug:hearts} was the very first to say hello.

es-ES.title: El largo sueño de Oruga
es-ES.text: Oruga {caterpillar:pulse} tenía hambre. {sfx:munch} Ñam, ñam, se comió una hoja. Ñam, ñam, se comió otra. [giggles] ¡Qué cosquillas!, se rio el árbol {tree:wobble 0.4}. Hasta que un día, Oruga dijo: [yawns] Tengo muchísimo sueño. Se envolvió bien apretada en una cajita, y se colgó de una rama, muy, muy quieta. {caterpillar:fade-out hold} Mariquita {ladybug:pulse} esperaba a su lado. Un día. Dos días. Muchos días. [curious] ¿Saldrá algún día?, le preguntó Mariquita al árbol. [softly] Espera y verás, dijo el árbol. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} Y una mañana de sol, la cajita se movió… y se abrió… y de dentro salió… [gasps] ¡una mariposa! {butterfly:fade-in} {butterfly:sparkle} Soy yo, dijo la mariposa. ¡Soy Oruga! [happily] Y Mariquita {ladybug:hearts} fue la primera en decirle hola.

munch.prompt: a tiny caterpillar munching a crisp green leaf, soft little bites
